Complete the WHERE clause to find movies released after the year 2000:

MATCH (m:Movie)
WHERE m.released -- select --
RETURN m.title, m.released

Complete the Cypher query to query a vector index named plotEmbeddings for the 5 most similar nodes:

MATCH (m:Movie)
	-- select -- m IN (
		VECTOR INDEX plotEmbeddings
		FOR myEmbedding
		LIMIT 5
	) SCORE AS score
RETURN m, score
